caption: The drawing features a green glass bottle with a short neck and a rounded rectangular body. On the front of the bottle is an embossed design depicting a bird in flight oriented to the right, with its wings extended. Above the bird, there is a ribbon-like banner that curves and winds behind its head and extends below the bird, ending underneath an acorn. Below the bird and acorn, there are small branch-like decorations with leaves on each side. Toward the bottom of the bottle, an empty, double-curved rectangular label section is depicted, likely intended for writing or engraving. The overall color of the bottle is a varied green with highlights and shadows, and the background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Liquor Flask
